title_en: Private house for sale in the center of Tirana
description_en: A private house for sale in the center of Tirana. The house is located near Barricadave street in a quiet and family area, it has 154 m² of land and 95 m² of building space, the apartment inside is of the type 2+1+2 toilets+separate kitchen while the terrace is insulated with concrete and carbon fiber where it currently serves as a veranda. It has a regular mortgage document. For more information, contact us
